description: This file defines the SiftConfig class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It manages configuration data related to 'Sift', including attributes, store configuration, uploader configuration, access to persistent storage, and plugin activation. It also includes mechanisms for observing changes in stored values.

classes.name: SiftConfig
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling Sift configuration, including attributes, store, uploader settings, and change notifications.

classes.name: SiftConfig::MonitorKeys
classes.description: Nested class implementing storage change notifications, allowing registration of callbacks on specific keys and namespaces.

methods.name: TriggerInitialization
methods.description: Starts the initialization process in a separate thread.

methods.name: InitializeKeysMap
methods.description: Initializes the internal map of keys.

methods.name: GetValueFromPersistent
methods.description: Retrieves a value from persistent storage.

methods.name: UpdateXboValues
methods.description: Updates internal values related to XBO.
